parsed.notes:
“Das wünschen wir uns” is read as a requirements heading, not an optional section; the invitation to apply without meeting every requirement does not change the labels.
“vorzugsweise”, “wünschenswert” and “idealerweise” are read literally as optional markers. “wünschenswert” applies to the entire CI/CD, containers and Platform/DevOps bullet.
Technologies appearing only under “Das erwartet Sie” are excluded. Longer quotes distinguish qualification mentions from responsibility-only mentions.
Azure OpenAI maps to Azure and OpenAI API; Azure is independently preferred in the cloud qualification.
Deployment, logging and fault analysis are explicitly requested through willingness to share operational responsibility; no AI-specific deployment skill is inferred.
Interest in AI applications alone is not treated as a request for AI/ML proficiency.
“Mehrjährige” indicates multiple years but gives no numerical range; mid is an uncertain inference, not a stated level.
